title: Automate assembly via GitHub Actions on source repo push

brief.why: Manual assemble.sh runs are error-prone (see bds-susezi for one example) and cause silent drift between source repos and the published marketplace. CI automation is the prerequisite for trusting spm1001/batterie as the single marketplace.
brief.what: 1. Create .github/workflows/assemble.yml in spm1001/batterie 2. Action checks out source repos: bon, trousse, passe, mise-en-space, garde-manger, consomme, todoist-gtd, batterie-de-savoir 3. Runs assemble.sh 4. Runs batterie-lint.py from batterie-de-savoir 5. If diff exists, opens a PR titled 'Reassemble — <date>' 6. Test with workflow_dispatch trigger 7. Add weekly schedule once proven
brief.done: Manual workflow_dispatch trigger produces a PR in spm1001/batterie with assembled content and lint passing. No human intervention required beyond merging the PR.
brief.how: Create a GitHub Action in spm1001/batterie. Start with workflow_dispatch (manual trigger) to prove it works, then add a weekly schedule. The action checks out all 8 source plugin repos, runs assemble.sh to copy their content into plugins/, runs scripts/batterie-lint.py from batterie-de-savoir for drift detection, and opens a PR with any changes. Never push directly to main — always PR so a human reviews the diff.

title: All batterie plugins work fully in Claude Desktop/Cowork

brief.why: Desktop/Cowork is the primary interface for non-CLI users. Plugins that only work in CLI are invisible to them. The suite has 8 plugins — all must work in both environments.
brief.what: Broken out into actions: 1. Fix SKILL.md frontmatter for Cowork backend (bds-suhame) 2. Test each plugin e2e in a Desktop Cowork session (bds-luguwo) 3. Add auto-install for CLI tools that skills depend on (bds-dacase)
brief.done: All 8 CLI marketplace plugins install, load skills, and function in a Desktop Cowork session without manual intervention. Plugins: batterie, bon, trousse, mise, passe, garde-manger, consomme, todoist-gtd.
brief.how: Three phases in sequence: (1) Fix SKILL.md frontmatter so plugins are visible in Cowork (bds-suhame), (2) Test each plugin end-to-end in a Cowork session (bds-luguwo), (3) Add runtime CLI install for skills that need it (bds-dacase). Assembly-related fixes live under the convergence outcome (bds-sucega) instead.
